title: Success Stories
intro: Urruty Labs works with early-stage founders to build or rebuild production-ready products. Each success story highlights real examples of senior technical leadership, fast iteration, architecture decisions, overcoming complexity, and preparing products for scale.

leanzupply.title: LeanZupply
leanzupply.subtitle: Strengthening the technical foundation of a D2B procurement platform
leanzupply.description: Building a production-ready MVP in 90 days for a founder with market fit and a proven business model. The engagement focused on translating a successful business model into a digital marketplace, establishing architecture that scales, and enabling initial traction in a complex D2B supply chain environment. Technical foundations built for scaling, with senior engineering judgment throughout.

encuentraya.title: EncuentraYa
encuentraya.subtitle: Building a production-ready search and discovery marketplace from the ground up
encuentraya.description: Delivering a production-ready MVP in 90 days for an early-stage Uruguayan marketplace startup. The engagement covered architecture design, core platform development, and senior technical leadership — translating a validated product vision into a scalable, live platform ready for user traction.
